title: Accelerated Evolution Humanoid Robot Booster K1 Exploration Edition Now on Sale, JD.com Price 38,999 Yuan

content_html:
Today, the Booster K1 Explorer Edition, an evolving humanoid robot, is officially on sale with a JD.com price of 38,999 yuan. Its self-positioning is clear - "entry-level full-body development platform", targeting developers who want to personally explore embodied intelligence.

The hardware parameters take a lightweight and compact approach: about 95cm in height, about 19.5kg in weight, with 22 degrees of freedom, easy for one person to carry and fit on a table. In terms of perception and interaction, it sees the world through dual-depth cameras, listens and speaks with a ring-shaped 3-microphone array and speaker. What truly brings these hardware components to life is the built-in DouBao large model - capabilities such as voice conversation and semantic understanding are ready to use out of the box.

What's more practical for developers is its openness: the body has 48TOPS dense computing power, supports open APIs for customization and DIY, and can be continuously upgraded through OTA. The pricing under 40,000 yuan combined with open interfaces means that the embodied intelligence experimental platforms that used to cost tens of thousands have been compressed into a robot that can be bought and modified at home.
